findings.text: The task says "The guide promises `belay-sql-check --costs`" and cites ADR 0017 S7 for "the target guide's stable-proof requirement", but neither `belay-sql-check`, `--costs`, nor heartbeats or costs appear in `docs/adr-0017-user-surface.md` (S7 at line 72 says only "the check tool") or in `docs/adr-0019-guide-sql.md`. Fix: cite the document that makes this promise (or say it is an owner request, per line 7) and drop the claim that the guide promises `--costs`.
